Integrations/Recruiting & HR

AI Ark

AI Ark provides people and company search, contact enrichment, and recruiting intelligence APIs.

19 actionsAPI key

Connect AI Ark

What your bot can do in AI Ark

Looks up

  • Analyze PersonalityInfer DISC and OCEAN personality assessments plus selling and hiring outreach guidance from one person's LinkedIn profile.
  • Enrich Person with EmailEnrich one person by AI Ark person ID or LinkedIn URL with a full profile and provider email-verification metadata.
  • Find Mobile PhoneFind candidate mobile phone numbers for one person from a LinkedIn URL or from a company domain plus full name.
  • Get Credit BalanceReturn the connected AI Ark account's remaining credit balance for free.
  • Get Email Finder StatusMake one free status request for an email-finder job and return its state and total/found counts.
  • Get People Export StatusMake one free status request for a bulk people-export job and return its state, total/found/success/failed counts, and webhook metadata.
  • List Email Finder ResultsReturn one free page of an email-finder job's results without waiting for completion.
  • List Email Finder SubmissionsReturn one free page of the connected AI Ark customer's email-finder submission history, including job states and refund details.
  • List People Export ResultsReturn one free page of a completed bulk people export.
  • List People Export SubmissionsList the authenticated API token's own people-export submission and refund history for free.
Show 4 more
  • Look Up Person by EmailIdentify and return a sensitive, detailed personal and employment profile from an email address.
  • Preview PeopleReturn one page of masked people and full company matches for 1 credit per page.
  • Search CompaniesReturn one zero-based page of companies using typed company, employee, list, and lookalike filters.
  • Search PeopleReturn one page of full people and company profiles.

Takes action

  • Create or Update ListCreate or mutate a temporary people/company exclusion list for free.
  • Resend Email Finder WebhookIrreversibly resend one email-finder completion payload to a caller-selected public HTTPS webhook.
  • Resend People Export WebhookIrreversibly resend one completed bulk people export to a caller-selected public HTTPS webhook.
  • Start Email FinderConsume a People Search track ID exactly once, within 6 hours of the search, to start email finding.
